articles.title: Owl Eye
articles.summary: Dark teal ground packed with tiny bronze, violet and teal shimmering dots, like a dense peacock-feather eye field. A big green and pink spiral eye on a dark teal ground; the dashes blur to a fine texture and the whorl reads as a peacock-green swirl.

Up close: One large whorl about 450 px wide, like an eye or rose spiral: lime-green, dark teal and pink-lilac bands curving around a small pinwheel centre. The whole whorl is covered in short slanted dashes, 5-9 px, in yellow-green, pink and black, like scales or feather barbs. Lit edges are bright lime and. From a distance: A big green and pink spiral eye on a dark teal ground; the dashes blur to a fine texture and the whorl reads as a peacock-green swirl. Measured spec (average): metal 101, roughness 107, coat 119. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

Thin white, black or silver stripes: only broad shapes read over the whorl

pitfalls: Not a dense field of tiny eyespots (old card): the picture is one big spiral whorl
Not an all-over texture: it is a single placed motif; check how the sheet maps it onto the car
